title: P0.28: External Failure Continuity Across Restart
description: After IABV restarted, follow-up messages like 'no veo la verificacion de seguridad' lost the in-memory _last_external_failure_payload and fell into Adaptive local orchestrator / Ollama instead of continuing the ChatGPT external failure context.
reason: The external failure guard was correct only while RAM survived. The universal loop was not crossing persisted runtime evidence back into the conversation after restart, so a visible user contradiction was treated as a fresh local chat.
next_action: No further action for this slice unless live runtime evidence shows security-verification follow-ups after restart entering Adaptive local orchestrator again.
resume_hint: LIVE_VERIFIED on Windows runtime: after restart, 'no veo la verificacion de seguridad' recovered the previous ChatGPT external_consultation block from runtime_audit.jsonl, emitted external_failure_context_recovered_from_runtime_audit, selected external_failure_shared_reality_dispute, suppressed local fallback, and resolved in ~221ms with live_status idle.

metadata.root_cause: In-memory-only external failure continuity. _last_external_failure_payload was lost on restart even though runtime_audit.jsonl still contained the external_consultation block and the user chat still referred to it.

fixes_applied.task_a: Added narrow recovery gate for security/browser/assistant follow-ups only.
fixes_applied.task_b: Added _recover_external_failure_from_runtime_audit() to rehydrate the last external_consultation block from runtime_audit.jsonl.
fixes_applied.task_c: Recovered payload remains explanatory context only; it does not decide routes or bypass governance.
fixes_applied.task_d: Added focused test for restart recovery: no memory payload + runtime_audit block + 'no veo la verificacion de seguridad' => external_failure_shared_reality_dispute.

live_proof.message: no veo la verificacion de seguridad

remaining_unresolved: startup_truth_refresh delays bridge readiness for ~155s under current runtime conditions
